hint.cases: Cases in the test half, separated by contract from the development half.
hint.decisionAccuracy: Cases whose decision matches the expected answer, with the lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval.
hint.fullMatch: Cases matching the decision, reason code, payable amount and penalty together.
hint.macroF1: Mean F1 of the four decision classes, estimated by contract.
hint.unauthorizedPayment: Cases paid while the expected answer is hold or reject, over the cases expected to be held or rejected, with the upper bound of the 95% Wilson interval. Target: 0.

kpi.title: KPIs
kpi.subtitle: {{labelled}} publicly labelled milestones; coverage, trace and time on {{milestones}} milestones

hint.decisionAccuracy: Milestones whose RELEASE/HOLD/REJECT/PENALTY decision matches the label, counted on the publicly labelled milestones only.
hint.macroF1: Mean F1 of the four decision classes, so rare classes (REJECT, PENALTY) are not drowned out by frequent ones.
hint.unauthorizedPayment: Milestones released or paid with penalty while the label is HOLD/REJECT, over the milestones labelled HOLD/REJECT. Target: 0.
hint.overHold: Milestones held or rejected while the label is RELEASE/PENALTY: shows the system is not safe merely by holding every payment.
hint.amountAccuracy: Milestones whose payable and penalty amounts both match exactly, with the largest absolute error (million VND).
hint.coverage: Milestones with exactly one output row, over the milestones to export.
hint.traceability: Decisions that trace back to their events (or missing conditions), rule, amounts, time and audit id.
hint.processing: Total time of one run, median and p95 per milestone. Hover the value for the machine configuration.
